marker_reviews.reason: The dynamic marker is the existence-guarded REVOKE EXECUTE loop over the 80 named revoke-candidate functions (issue #6457). No sidecar check kind can assert role privileges: the supported kinds are exact_row_count, catalog_contract and catalog_absence, none of which expresses has_function_privilege state. The durable proof is the in-migration assertion (the same DO block raises if any in-scope anon/authenticated/PUBLIC EXECUTE grant survives on the revoke set) plus the preview after-census and issue #6457's acceptance check. Same shape and rationale as the #6415 sidecar for migration 20261116013153.
